# R Family Keepsakes

> A small bindery in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, USA, that makes and sells six family keepsake goods by mail: a family
> history record book, a family recipe binder, a baby memory book, the Rocket Pool summer journal for children, an
> acid-free keepsake box and a family tree wall chart. Goods only: no family history research, no photo printing,
> no personalized embossing, no shipping outside the USA.

## Price list (USD)
- Family history record book: $58
- Family recipe binder: $42
- Baby memory book: $48
- Rocket Pool summer journal: $24
- Acid-free keepsake box: $36
- Family tree wall chart: $32

Standard shipping is called Original Delivery: gift-wrapped and tracked, $7 per order to the 48 contiguous
states and Washington, DC, $14 to Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico. Two-Day Delivery is $19 per order.

## Pages
- https://rfamilyfinancial.com/ : what the bindery makes, the price list, how an order runs, common questions
- https://rfamilyfinancial.com/family-record-books.html : the record book and the baby memory book, page by page; how the books are bound
- https://rfamilyfinancial.com/recipe-binders-and-boxes.html : the recipe binder, the keepsake box and the Rocket Pool summer journal, with sizes
- https://rfamilyfinancial.com/family-tree-planner.html : a family tree planner (pedigree rule, 2 to 7 generations) and the three wall chart layouts
- https://rfamilyfinancial.com/about-r-family.html : about the bindery, what it will and will not do
- https://rfamilyfinancial.com/shipping-and-gift-wrap.html : shipping costs, times, gift wrap, lost parcels
- https://rfamilyfinancial.com/returns-and-replacements.html : 30-day returns, refunds, faulty goods, exchanges
- https://rfamilyfinancial.com/order-keepsakes.html : the order form; nothing is charged until the bindery replies with a total
